recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Federative Republic of Brazil. Federal presidential republic.
rulers: President Luiz Inácio LULA da Silva (since 1 January 2023)
economy: upper-middle-income, largest Latin American economy; Mercosur, BRICS, G20 member and OECD accession candidate; growth driven by strong domestic consumption; monetary tightening helping curb inflation rate; high inequality in income and access to health and education GDP (PPP): $4.165 trillion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Brazilian Armed Forces (Forças Armadas Brasileiras): Brazilian Army (Exercito Brasileiro, EB), Brazilian Navy (Marinha do Brasil; includes Naval Aviation (Aviacao Naval Brasileira) and Marine Corps (Corpo de Fuzileiros Navais)), Brazilian Air Force (Forca Aerea Brasileira) (2025) Expenditure: 1.1% of GDP (2024 est.)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
